verdict: DEAD (instrument: KILL by the pre-registered rule, every cell > 17.25; gate >= 279 connected takes at <= 4 contacts fails in every cell). Best cell L0b (the lead's seats, stop B 76.04, K dyad 32 / 52): 17.69 connected = static (277 ws takes, 13 contacts, ib14 0.8862, follow 1.0; near-touch 22.11; kit 18.26). The plan's L0 (bk1 26) cannot carry stop B 76.04: the K rule forces bk2 >= 55.55 and the flat K triangle (26 / 37.55 / 55.56) puts link 1b over hub 1 (0.89 mm in every state-A pose) - 165.18 static. Control C0 (lead seats, the lead's stroke 58.77, kit metal): 20.52 connected / 18.83 static (255 / 261 takes, 5 contacts, ib14 0.9128). J1 forward on the k33 seats: S1 (+15) 21.73, S2 (+25) 22.91 (k33 control 17.25): ER binders 117 / 148 clear at S2 (0.79 / 0.66 mm) but in-band falls to 0.8816 and the overhead clip frames 7-11 / 234 / 290 stay in the skin (contacts 26-27 vs ~21). No-go on 'longer stroke on the lead' (bound 17.69 > 13.75 even before its 13 contacts; at zero contact 277 takes would read 13.06 only with ib14 >= 0.90, which the stroke itself costs) and on 'J1 forward' (worse than its own seat).
limiter: Stretched poses the stroke newly closes carry their own contacts: L0b vs C0 newly closes 24 ws poses (13 clear, 2 near, 9 in the skin: 119 -13.2, 405 -10.3, 448 -5.1, 399 -4.6, 117 -2.2, 372 -1.8, 423 -1.3, 431 -0.8, 343 -0.5 mm) with the best legal K already picked by the oracle, and the stroke costs in-band (fast: ib14 0.909 -> 0.886 at equal K dyad). J1 forward trades the ER wall (117 / 148 cleared) for the overhead clip (frames 7-11 in the skin at -3.5..-4.4 mm) and in-band. Overhead clip frames 7-11 / 234 / 290 are TAKEN at the lead's seats (C0 1.5-1.9 mm, L0b 0.3-0.9 mm) and in the skin at the k33 / forward seats: the '9 overhead parking contacts' are a seat property (J1 az), not a K property.
note: Instrument, never a claim; no search, so the convergence gate does not apply (4 pre-registered cells + the L0 repair; plan cap 4 exact cells, 5 exact wears run because L0 as specified jams). Spec corrections: L0 bk2 55.04 / C0 bk2 38.0336 break the K rule a1max <= bk1 + bk2 - 5.5 (k_ok False, every pose refused); raised to 55.56 / 38.28; L0 at 55.56 then jams (L1b-hub1), so L0b uses the k33 K dyad 32 / 52. Cell 4 = C0 (stroke control) instead of L1: acroant-conecut died by its pre-registered stop. Proxy check: L0 predicted 27 newly closing (15 clear / 2 near / 10 skin), measured 24 (13 / 2 / 9) - the proxy's pose classes hold; its gap (16.0-16.6) was 1.1-1.7 optimistic (in-band). S1 binder shifts vs k33: 117 +1.08, 119 +3.35, 129 +1.05, 148 -0.62 mm (proxy +1.1 / +3.1 / +2.0 / +0.2). Kit metal, not the lead's drive: 237 / 264 are contacts here at every seat (L0b -14.7 / -7.4) - the kit's parking metal, not the lead's crank / lobe. Per-part in-band (L2 / hub 2 / hub K) not computed (no per-part band tool in this harness).
